svg.title: Holman Fig. 6-6 — turbulent thermal-entry Nusselt numbers, q_w = constant
svg.text: Holman Fig. 6-6 — turbulent thermal-entry Nusselt numbers, qw = constant
Nux/Nu∞ against x/D for circular tubes (digitized from the slide chart)
dashed: Re = 1×10⁵ with Pr = 0.01, 0.7, 10 (top to bottom)
x/D, distance from the tube inlet in diameters
Mark x/D = L/d = 10/2 = 5 on the x/D axis (see the zoom).
Go straight up to the Pr = 0.7 curve (Re = 5×10⁴ to 2×10⁵; air, Re = 50,988).
Go across to the Nux/Nu∞ axis.
Read Nux/Nu∞ ≈ 1.15: h is about 15% above the fully developed value.
Redrawn from the slide chart; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
